strategy: Clear simple and cumulative trophies during the campaign while starting long-term goals early: research, item rerolls, NPC questlines, diplomacy, population constraints and regional culture choices.

roadmap.name: De Novo
roadmap.reason: Very quick and harmless to your save, so it is worth clearing immediately.

roadmap.name: Scientia Potestas Est
roadmap.reason: Progresses naturally through research and directly builds toward Polygnostic.

roadmap.name: City Watched
roadmap.reason: A simple Latium construction objective that fits naturally into your main city.

roadmap.name: Aqueduct Vitae
roadmap.reason: An isolated construction challenge that is easiest to plan on an island with enough free space.

roadmap.name: Travelling Sails Problem
roadmap.reason: Best done while your trade network is still expanding.

roadmap.name: Cura Annonae
roadmap.reason: Naturally combines your Albion and Latium development.

roadmap.name: Hic Svnt Dracones
roadmap.reason: Exploring all of Albion supports several later Celtic objectives.

roadmap.name: Polygnostic
roadmap.reason: Focus research into one category instead of spreading Inspirations across several categories.

roadmap.name: Life Support
roadmap.reason: NPC questlines are easy to neglect, so keep Tarragon's chain moving whenever it appears.

roadmap.name: Questing Beast
roadmap.reason: Keep Athr Iorgwyn's questline moving while developing Albion.

roadmap.name: Lily Buy-in
roadmap.reason: Complete Valeria's quests as they appear rather than leaving the whole chain for endgame cleanup.

roadmap.name: Fuelling The Flame
roadmap.reason: Concordia's full questline is another long-form objective that is safer to progress early.

roadmap.name: Alea Iacta Est
roadmap.reason: A long cumulative grind: start rerolling item offers regularly now instead of farming the full amount later.

roadmap.name: Morituri Te Salutant
roadmap.reason: Requires a developed city and stable economy, so tackle it once your Amphitheater infrastructure is comfortable.

roadmap.name: Si Vis Pacem
roadmap.reason: Plan this before eliminating too many rivals: you need war and then peace with three separate rivals.

roadmap.name: Patrician Tastes
roadmap.reason: Much easier when an island is designed around the population restriction from the beginning.

roadmap.name: Not Built In A Day
roadmap.reason: Keep one main Campaign save alive until it passes the 24-hour requirement.

roadmap.name: Quid Pro Quo
roadmap.reason: A long-term prestige objective that is best treated as a late-game milestone.

De Novo.tip: Use the Cosmetic Tool to change a building's skin nine times. Space4Games explicitly recommends treating this as passive cleanup, so knock it out as soon as the tool is available.

Scientia Potestas Est.tip: Fulfill nine Research Inspirations during normal development. Keep research active instead of letting it idle, because the same habit directly helps with Polygnostic later.

Polygnostic.tip: Concentrate your research choices in one category until every Inspiration in that category is unlocked. Space4Games specifically recommends focusing one category rather than spreading progress around.

Alea Iacta Est.tip: Start this early. You need to spend 170,100 Denarii on item-offer rerolls, and Space4Games calls it a long-term objective. Refresh offers regularly throughout the campaign instead of trying to grind the entire amount at the end.

Morituri Te Salutant.tip: Host nine Amphitheater events. Build toward this only once your city has the required status, strong infrastructure and a stable economy so repeated events do not destabilize the rest of your settlement.

Quid Pro Quo.tip: Treat Proconsul as a long-term campaign milestone. Reputation and overall strategic development are the real grind here, so keep progressing your strongest save rather than trying to force this trophy early.

Si Vis Pacem.tip: The order matters: wage war against three different rivals, then successfully broker peace with them. Do not eliminate rivals you may still need for this trophy.

Patrician Tastes.tip: Plan a dedicated island around the restriction from the start and raise it to the required city status without any Liberti or Plebeians. Designing for the condition early is much easier than trying to retrofit a mature island.

Not Built In A Day.tip: The requirement is more than 24 hours in a single Campaign game. Keep one main campaign save and continue building on it instead of constantly restarting new campaign files.

Fuelling The Flame.tip: Complete every Concordia quest. When her next quest becomes available, prioritize it so story choices or later rival actions do not leave the chain forgotten.

Life Support.tip: Complete Tarragon's entire questline. Treat NPC quest chains as campaign-long objectives and clear each step when it becomes available.

Questing Beast.tip: Complete all of Athr Iorgwyn's quests. Keep the chain active while developing Albion instead of leaving it for a late cleanup pass.

Lily Buy-in.tip: Complete all of Valeria's quests as they appear. This is safer than trying to reconstruct a neglected quest chain after your campaign has moved much further forward.

Haec Ornamenta Mea.tip: Place the 50 ornaments gradually while beautifying an island. Space4Games recommends letting cosmetic trophies like this progress passively during normal city development.

Heavier Than A Feather.tip: Before committing to eliminating Neferneru, double-check any remaining diplomacy trophies that still require active rivals. Once those are safe, treat this as a dedicated military objective.

Romani Ite Domum.tip: Prepare an Albion island specifically for Celtic population growth and avoid Romanising any resident there. Planning the island around the restriction is safer than trying to undo Romanisation later.

patternTips.tip: Use every expansion to improve your trade network. Several trophies involve route count, stop count and cross-region connections, so design routes to satisfy multiple requirements at once.
For NPC questline trophies, complete missions as soon as they appear and avoid letting diplomacy or campaign choices stall a character's chain for too long.
Before eliminating a rival, check every remaining diplomacy trophy. Some objectives require rivals to stay available for war, peace or alliance interactions.
Plan island dedications deliberately. Several trophies depend on specific deities, regions or repeated patron choices, so avoid distributing patron selections randomly.

Population trophies are easier with a dedicated island plan. Reserve enough housing, supply chains and workforce capacity early instead of trying to squeeze the target into an already optimized island.
